facts.fact: Devan carries Kannan's white pebble in his belt pouch at the Resin House and puts it in his cheek at dusk of ch 17 although Neela took no resin, to slow his own words while angry.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the pebble at dusk with no resin; consistent with F175/F327.

facts.fact: Devan made his slow open-hand drill at twenty-five, the winter after the ford, ending with two fingers stopped a hair short of the post.
facts.why: needed to give the hand-mastering drill a history.

facts.fact: Pavi offers a clay pot of green salve; Devan has it left on Chathu's desk for Neela. He also sets a brass water pot spout-left by her mat and has the mat moved away from the door.
Devan decides not to hand the Keeper's quire to Rema until he has heard all eleven contracts, and will not lie to Rema about the lookout leaf.
facts.why: needed to set the chapter's goal and the reader question.
